name: 11P Gun Counter Trey Lead (Detroit Back-Side Deception)
formation: 11P Gun Trips Left vs Nickel Under

summary.motive: Use pre-snap counter step and dual pulling guard deception to freeze linebackers and create an explosive B-gap crease.
summary.whyItWorks: The counter false step freezes both box linebackers for a half-second while the double-pull simultaneously creates both the kick-out and the lead block; by the time defenders react, two pullers have already cleared the gap.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined 3-tech DT with gap-control discipline who defeats the center reach and disrupts the pull timing before the guards can set up their blocks.

beats.title: 1. Counter Step Misdirection
beats.text: The running back takes a false step weakside and the QB reverses pivot — two simultaneous misdirection cues freeze both linebackers who cannot identify the point of attack for a critical half-second.

beats.title: 2. Dual Pull Action
beats.text: Left Guard pulls playside as a kick-out blocker and Right Guard leads through the B-gap to log the MIKE linebacker. Johnson weaponizes two pullers to create a wide-open running lane that a traditional counter trey achieves with one.

beats.title: 3. Point of Attack Crease
beats.text: LG kicks out the Nickel while RG logs the scraping MIKE. The RB presses through a massive hole in the B-gap with only the free safety unblocked in the secondary.

beats.title: 4. Explosive YAC to Second Level
beats.text: With the front seven blocked out and receivers stalking the cornerbacks, the running back cuts upfield into open grass. Ben Johnson's counter deception has neutralized every defender in the box.

relations.tell: Both guards pull simultaneously in same direction; RB counter false step with QB reverse pivot before handoff.
